# Inline video fixture

`inline-video.mp4` is an original 320×180 synthetic color/text clip generated for Dorham tests, with a quiet 440 Hz AAC test tone. It contains no third-party footage. Browser WebM source is generated by `makeVideo()` in `tests/media-fixtures.ts`.

To reproduce after running the guarded inline-media browser test:

```
ffmpeg -hide_banner -loglevel error -y -i artifacts/evidence/v04-inline-video.webm -f lavfi -i sine=frequency=440:sample_rate=48000 -filter:a volume=0.02 -shortest -c:v libx264 -preset ultrafast -pix_fmt yuv420p -c:a aac -b:a 32k -movflags +faststart -threads 1 tests/fixtures/inline-video.mp4
```

The tiny committed fixture lets browser and installed Electron tests verify actual H.264 MP4 decoding without needing FFmpeg at test time. WebM decoding uses freshly recorded VP8 media. The SQL fixtures in this directory separately preserve historical migration inputs.
